requirements.name: RF measurement experience
requirements.note: Text describes optical/photonics measurement and calibration work (photoluminescence, hyperspectral, INSO 17025), not RF test-bench work; no RF-specific instrumentation is named.

requirements.name: Relevant degree or demonstrated equivalent

lines.quote: Developed an automated photoluminescence signal classification system for wafer-level defect screening, reducing false-positive rates in production testing by approximately 22%

requirements.note: Degree is in materials science and engineering, not electrical engineering, physics or applied mathematics by name; whether it counts as a closely adjacent field, or whether the 16-year record of optical signal-processing algorithm work demonstrates equivalent competence, is a judgement call for the recruiter.

lines.quote: Finnish citizen, returned to Oulu after completing studies in Aachen.

Wrote and consolidated English-language technical documentation across Hohtola’s Oulu and Munich offices, producing unified measurement protocol templates and standardised test report formats for the optical sensor division
I live in Oulu and have been here for most of my career.

ask_in_screening.question: Can you describe any experience you have designing or implementing phased-array or beamforming signal-processing algorithms, if any?
Can you describe any experience you have writing production embedded signal-processing software in C or C++ running on real hardware, if any?
Can you describe any experience you have writing Python to production or engineering standards, if any?
Can you describe any hands-on RF test-bench measurement experience you have, such as with network analysers, spectrum analysers, or anechoic-chamber testing, if any?
